summary: Targeted retest of poster brand-color propagation (iter16). Verified header band, WhatsApp share footer banner, and Last Date InfoCard all repaint using the chosen accent color from ShareModal palette. Tested emerald (#059669), red (#b91c1c), and default navy fallback. Also confirmed iter15 regressions still hold: vac-mode-offline chip present (online chip absent), palette has 8 swatches with expected IDs.
critical_code_review_comments: Poster.jsx now correctly derives brand/brandGradient at the top of the component (lines 105-109) and reuses them for header (~line 130), Last Date InfoCard iconBg/labelColor (lines 386/388) and WhatsApp share banner (line 542). No self-reference bug, `brand` and `brandGradient` defined once.
Poster.jsx is 635 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting InfoCard and shop-contact block into their own files for maintainability.
